meta.title: Concurrent bids from many vendors are all recorded
gaps: the part about “concurrent” is outside what an API plan on a sourcing event checks

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that reads the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
